entry: signal+1 trading session raw index open, paper research proxy observed in next postclose record; no actual execution claim
exit: fixed horizon close, entry session counts as day1
timeout_semantics: trigger allowed on wait days1..10; after day10 failed trigger expire without rearm that day
first_state: empty on first observed day; historical prices only warm features, no historical setups/events imported
missing_policy: missing data or observation gap cancels waiting; never reconstruct unobserved events or price fills; missing path cannot be a win
market_close_gate: both current clock and payload generated_at must be today after15:10 Asia/Shanghai; payload timestamp cannot be future
earliest_recording: 2026-10-19 post15:10; next scheduled existing daily workflow17:15, no new scheduler
scope: independent observational paper portfolios per rule and horizon; no score/weight/order changes; do not combine correlated portfolios into independent evidence
review: 3 and6 calendar months from first valid observation; elapsed months alone do not prove statistical adequacy
data_scope: CY official CNI native amount, Tencent raw OHLC cross-check with CNI OHLC and fresh payload history; no ETF amount substitution
